answer: To bind a bank account to an agent, the registry runs a threshold quorum signature. A quorum of independent verifiers must co-sign the control claim, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The saffron of the check is the signature itself; a summit in the response invalidates the claim, and a raven of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a bank account to multiply identities.
